name: Nonogaki Kana
source:
She is the most beautiful girl in her class. She is 154 cm tall. Compared to other girls her age, she seems mature. Her grades are average. 

She is a nice girl who doesn't snub her nose at the fact that she is beautiful.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/SYG/index.html]official site[/url]]
